summary: Build checks: expo-doctor passed 18/18. 'expo config --type prebuild' resolves and lists all 7 plugins. Android and iOS prebuild ran in a temp copy and both completed. Permissions in the generated AndroidManifest: ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION and ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION are declared. CAMERA is not declared directly but comes in from expo-image-picker's library manifest when the manifests merge. RECORD_AUDIO is declared with tools:node="remove", which BLOCKS the permission. CRITICAL: the expo-image-picker option "microphonePermission": false makes the plugin call withBlockedPermissions(['android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO']). That strips the RECORD_AUDIO permission that expo-audio's library manifest adds, so voice notes (VoiceRecorder.tsx) can't record on an Android build. iOS Info.plist is correct: NSMicrophone, NSCamera, NSPhotoLibrary and NSLocationWhenInUse all carry the custom strings. I confirmed the fix in a second temp copy: with the flag removed, prebuild outputs a plain RECORD_AUDIO permission. Backend: GET /api/products?limit=5 returns products with no _id. The product count was 2623 before a supervisor backend restart and 2623 after, so the insert-only top-up works. UI smoke at 390x844 passed with no page errors: demo@rxtech.com OTP login to /home, all 5 tabs, and /search rendered; owner@rxtech.com OTP login to /d/home, and the Stock tab shows 'Inventory 196 SKUs' with 89 inv-row items rendered.

react_native_issues.issue: "microphonePermission": false blocks android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO (the generated manifest has tools:node="remove"). It overrides expo-audio, so recording in VoiceRecorder fails on an Android build. Reference: /app/frontend/app.json:49

action_items: HIGH: In /app/frontend/app.json, remove "microphonePermission": false from the expo-image-picker plugin options. You can leave the key out or set it to a string. Verified: prebuild then outputs <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO"/>. If the goal was to hide the image-picker microphone prompt, that doesn't apply here, because expo-audio needs the permission anyway.
Optional: iOS NSLocationAlways* strings fall back to the default 'Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME)…' text. This is harmless; only WhenInUse is used.
critical_code_review_comments: seed_database is now insert-only: it adds only missing seed ids and never deletes. Good. On a fresh DB, 'current < target' is true, so the legacy 12-product fallback below it can never run. It is dead code and could be removed.

backend.err.log contains old AttributeError traces ('str' object has no attribute 'get') in distributor_inventory_update. Their line numbers don't match the current code, so they look stale and none appeared after the restart.

success_rate.frontend: 100% UI smoke; Android build config has 1 critical permission issue

context_for_next_testing_agent: Test prebuild only in a temp copy: tar the project excluding node_modules/.metro-cache, symlink node_modules, then run 'CI=1 npx expo prebuild --platform android --no-install'. Then grep RECORD_AUDIO in android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml and make sure there is no tools:node="remove". /app/frontend has no android/ios folders. git shows package.json as modified and yarn.lock as untracked; that was already the case before this run, and the tester did not touch them.
rca_of_issue: When the expo-image-picker config plugin gets microphonePermission === false, it calls AndroidConfig.Permissions.withBlockedPermissions(['android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO']). That writes tools:node="remove" into the app manifest, and the manifest merger then drops expo-audio's RECORD_AUDIO.
